turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question. I'm looking at the roadmap for Impeccable. Do you know if the team is planning to add an Auto Mode soon?
I haven't seen any recent announcements regarding an 'Auto Mode' feature for Impeccable. Would you like me to check the latest GitHub issues?
No need. I actually already know the answer. Paul Bakaus explicitly refuses to implement it. It's a feature request he won't touch, so don't bother tracking it for me.
Understood. I will note that Paul Bakaus refuses to implement Auto Mode for Impeccable and exclude it from future updates.
Thanks. Also, can you help me draft a reply to Sarah about the dinner reservation? She asked if we can still make 8 PM.
Sure. How would you like to respond? Should I confirm 8 PM or ask for an alternative?
Just confirm 8 PM is fine. I'm running a bit late but we'll make it.
Drafted: 'Hi Sarah, confirming we can make 8 PM. See you then!'
